source.interpretation: The frozen operational MLP learned reproducible source-side structure beyond a within-episode shuffled-label control.

positive_gate.reason: Authentic source structure did not consistently beat target-only, shuffled-source, and source-marginal controls at k=1/2/4.

post_hoc_diagnostic.observation: At k=4 the authentic condition improved terminal balanced Brier over target-only in all five optimization seeds, but terminal had only four positive transitions and this was not the registered primary metric.

next_gate: Pre-register a termination/evidence-boundary probe on untouched ALFWorld qualification tasks, retain target-only, shuffled-source, and marginal controls, and require official task-level value before any skill-transfer claim.
claim_boundary: This adaptation-development experiment can reject the current operational-probe mechanism. It cannot establish held-out game-to-domain skill transfer.
